cards.title: Morrisseau Fakes: What Robot Copies Reveal
cards.angle: Police have identified just over 1,600 fake Morrisseau works, and prosecutors say thousands more exist. The Morrisseau estate and NORVAL AI reviewed the robot-painted copies and identified errors that Acrylic worked to correct (Tara Deschamps, The Canadian Press, July 20, 2025).
cards.evidence: Your robot has replicated five Morrisseau works with the estate. CBC reported in July 2025 that newer copies scored about 69% against Norval AI. Early copies were caught because the robot paused mid-stroke to reload paint. The Art Newspaper reported authorized copies priced from C$3,240 to C$45,000. Your store blog covered the launch in July 2025, so this piece should lead with the numbers, not recap the story.
cards.formatNote: It is built on the brand's own public figures: five works, a 69% score, the stroke-pause finding and the price range.

cards.title: Robotic Painting Explained: Where Humans Decide
cards.angle: Acrylic's robot does not choose the art: people brief, direct and approve it. The robot works in acrylic only and cannot splatter or finger-paint.
cards.evidence: Your homepage lays out the chain. The designer shares a vision, your system proposes concepts, the designer refines, your robots paint, and your team delivers. Your founder told MobileSyrup in December 2024 that a painting takes a few hours, up to 12 for complex work, with automated paint refills. No article on your site explains the process end to end.
cards.formatNote: "Robotic painting" is a category term Acrylic can own, and every other piece can link back to it.

cards.title: Artist Royalties in Hotel Art: Paid Per Piece
cards.angle: Canada's median artist income is about $30,000, 39% below the typical worker, per Hill Strategies' analysis of 2021 census data. Acrylic pays a royalty on every piece that ships, but it does not publish the rate, so the post should not imply one.
cards.evidence: Your artists page says artists keep their originals, get credit on every reproduction, can decline any project, and choose to be named, aliased or unattributed. Your founder told AFP in September 2025 that the model rests on consent, credit and compensation. She also said her own painting once worked out to about $2 an hour.
cards.formatNote: The "$2 an hour" origin story is one founder claim, and artists already follow Chloë's feed.
